articles.summary: An initial pioneer ALG11-CDG family blazed a trail with a pilot 2,200-compound screen, paving the way for a second ALG11-CDG family to grab the baton and fund a comprehensive 8,400-compound screen.
articles.title: Two nutraceuticals are the top drug repurposing hits for ALG11-CDG

articles.summary: Fibroblasts and flies joined forces in a multi-species drug repurposing campaign that yielded p38 MAPK inhibitors as top rescuers for this ultra-rare mitochondrial disease.
articles.title: ECHS1 Cure Odyssey

articles.summary: When a disease is both rare and new to medicine, the only recourse is research. FAM177A1 Research Fund is excited to shared preliminary results from a foundation-sponsored biomarker discovery project.
articles.title: Biomarker discovery for FAM177A1
